summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Thrivent Mid Cap Value ETF (TMVE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in mid cap equity. The fund seeks long-term capital growth by actively managing a portfolio of undervalued US mid-cap companies. The fund uses fundamental analysis to select equity securities. TMVE was launched on Nov 17, 2025 and is issued by Thrivent.

holdings.infoBox: TMVE is an equity ETF with a total of 84 individual holdings. The top holdings are M&T Bank stock at 2.27%, U.S. Bancorp at 2.12%, Crown Holdings at 2.03%, Intercontinental Exchange at 2.03%, and American International Group at 1.93%.
